blocks.text: Surrey houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in Surrey peaked at 1,188 in September 2025 and bottomed at 808 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in May 2026 with 97. The reported sale price moved from $1,375,000 to $1,215,000, a change of −11.6%.
